summary.text: Chris Duerr is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 18, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia's campaign-finance listing records that Chris Duerr lost the 2022 general election for New Hampshire House of Representatives Rockingham 18.
